mainEntity.name: How do we evaluate analytics for production readiness?

acceptedAnswer.text: We evaluate production readiness with repeatable scorecards across correctness, recovery, governance, and rerun consistency. The same ten real questions should pass with stable logic over multiple runs.

mainEntity.name: Why do prompt-only SQL demos fail later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt-only systems often hide assumptions and fail silently under schema changes. That is why databricks genie natural language to sql should be evaluated with execution logs, reviewer sign-off, and post-incident learning loops. Teams standardizing governance across sources often keep [Natural Language to SQL Guide](/blog/natural-language-to-sql) beside this runbook for Sql handoffs.

mainEntity.name: Is benchmark rank enough to choose a platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Benchmarks provide useful directional signals, but deployment outcomes depend on context grounding, policy enforcement, and the quality of operational controls.

mainEntity.name: When should teams involve human reviewers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Human review is essential for high-stakes reporting, regulated domains, and any workflow where business definitions are ambiguous or recently updated.

mainEntity.name: Why position InfiniSynapse as a SQL agent, not just a text-to-SQL app?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Because production teams need complete workflow traceability. InfiniSynapse focuses on auditable execution paths, reusable memory, and safer recurring operations.
